description: B7's radar owner test. The map WK Hail T rains WK_HAIL_T, a HAILSTORM with targetable=1 and default damage 0, over Show Down; the player holds two solar collectors in the west, so most stones land out of the player's sight, where the radar rebuild's marker branch for a targetable projectile reads its attacker's owner (0x4673B1) -- a stone has none. Stock faults there; with B7 the stone is not the local player's and the branch goes on. The stones in sight take the branch's colour path through owner 10's record. Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into the instance's gamedir.
